summary: The Soldier is a pure ranged weapon profession: it wins by keeping an Assault Rifle firing with Burst and Full Auto while a stack of reflect and absorb nanos holds the damage off. So its gear is chosen for (1) the weapon skills and specials that let it hold a higher-QL gun - Assault Rifle, Burst, Full Auto, Fling Shot, Ranged Init.; (2) Add All Off. and damage modifiers; (3) Max Health and ACs, because Body Dev. is its second-cheapest skill and the reflect layer is spread over that HP pool; and (4) the Strength/Stamina/Agility that gate its own armour. It does NOT want nano-skill armour the way a caster does - the only nano skills it needs are Matter Creation and Time & Space, and those are better bought with buffs and symbiants than with armour. Every armour piece, requirement, bonus and profession lock below was read out of the client item pack, not from a guide. Weapons are in soldier-weapons.json, implants in soldier-implants.json and symbiants (Artillery line) in soldier-symbiants.json - they are deliberately NOT repeated here.

dataSources.expansionGate: ToWear stat 389 (Expansion) BitAnd: bit 2 = Shadowlands, bit 8 = Alien Invasion, bit 32 = Lost Eden. This is the authoritative expansion signal, not a guide.
dataSources.sideGate: ToWear stat 33 (Side) EqualTo: 1 = Clan, 2 = Omni. This is what separates the Chosen (Omni) and Faithful (Clan) suits and the Omni-only tank armour.

_unverified: Pernicious Armor: wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Armorsets places it under 'Dynaboss Armor', but WHICH Shadowlands dynabosses drop which piece was not established from a page I actually read. A search-engine summary claimed 'drops off dragon mobs in most SL zones'; that claim was NOT confirmed on a real page and is therefore not recorded as fact.
Notum Infused Kevlar Armor: the item data proves it is Soldier-only, QL1-200, level 180+. Its SOURCE (shop, quest, drop or tradeskill) was not established.

Omni-Pol Trooper Armor: Soldier-only in the data, base version QL1 and 'Quality' version QL200. Source not established; its stat block was not summarised because the QL1 templates carry almost nothing.
Miy's Ranged Armor drop camps: the Miy's family is known to drop from Medusae-type mobs, but the specific camps for the RANGED variant (as opposed to the Nano variant) were not confirmed on a page.

Ofab upgrade economics: 'Ofab -> Improved -> Penultimate with Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clumps, each clump at least 80% of the item QL' is carried over from soldier-endgame.json, which cites wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Ofab_Armor_Upgrades and the AO-Universe Ofab upgrade guide. Not independently re-read for this file.
Item DURATIONS, set bonuses and any 'wearing N pieces gives X' mechanic are not in the item pack and are not asserted anywhere in this file.
Bonus numbers are the TOP-QL template of each model. Mid-QL values scale but the exact scaling curve is not recorded here - read the QL you actually hold.

The two ids listed per Ofab/Tier piece (e.g. 264431 and 264432) are two templates of the same model in items.ocp (the low-QL and high-QL ends of the QL1-300 range). Which one a vendor/drop actually hands you was not determined.
